sections.title: US proposes tariffs on China and its own allies
sections.body: The US Trade Representative proposed tariffs of up to 20% on 14 economies on 25 November, including China, India, the EU, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan, after a probe into excess capacity. China's rate matches its truce level, with 40% signalled if talks fail. Beijing said it reserves the right to respond; Japan and the EU protested. Rates go to public comment, with action possible in January.

sections.title: Drone attack in Kuwait kills two Italian technicians
sections.body: Two Italian Rheinmetall technicians servicing an air-defence system died in Kuwait on 26 November after drones hit a 'vital site'. Kuwait and Italy blamed Iran; Tehran denied it and offered a joint investigation. It follows Iran's 18 November drone attack on a US base in Kuwait. At sea, 10 tankers were reported struck near Hormuz on 16-22 November, none attributed.

sections.title: Ukraine strikes deeper as Russia readies a mass attack
sections.body: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Tula region and St Petersburg overnight into 27 November and seriously damaged a Krasnodar refinery on 26 November; industry sources say Russian refining is down 45% since late October. Zelensky warned of another massive Russian strike while US Patriot interceptors stay unsigned. Latvia scrambled NATO jets over a drone on its border.

sections.title: Russia's war dead counted from its own records
sections.body: Leaked Rosstat records analysed by Meduza and Mediazona show at least 490,000 Russian military deaths registered by late September. Adding soldiers missing in action and registration delays, the authors estimate more than 700,000. The Kremlin declined to comment. The figures count deaths only and are not comparable with Ukraine's tally of killed and wounded.

sections.title: Poland moves to a no-fly zone on its Ukraine border
sections.body: Poland will create a no-fly zone at least 10 km deep along its Ukraine border, with rules due by early January letting pilots engage targets without visual identification. It follows Russian cruise missiles on its soil on 20 November and a drone over Lublin on 23 November. Trump and Rutte jointly urged Russia not to widen the war.

sections.title: Washington tells Americans to leave Iran
sections.body: The US told its citizens on 25 November to leave Iran immediately, warning that hostilities could escalate rapidly and that Iran, the Houthis and aligned groups may target US interests. Trump said the war is funded through the end of January. No US strike on Iranian territory has been reported since 17 November.

key_developments: Two Italian technicians were killed in Kuwait by a drone attack Kuwait and Italy blame on Iran; Iran denies it.
Trump says he sent an extra carrier and would strike Pickaxe Mountain if fighting resumes.
Ukrainian drones hit Tula and St Petersburg; Latvia scrambled NATO jets over a border drone.
EU report: Russia's January-September crude revenue of $102bn already exceeds all of 2025.
Ukrainian intelligence claims North Korea paused arms deliveries to Russia; unverified.
Turkey completed ratification of the Mecca defence pact with Saudi Arabia and Pakistan.
since_last_visit_brief: A drone attack in Kuwait, which Kuwait and Italy blame on Iran, killed two Italian technicians, and Trump said he sent another aircraft carrier.
